title: New models: Tenant, TenantMembership and TenantDomain
description:
Outcome: Three new models, each a new table created with all its indexes in one deploy (the one-new-index-per-deploy limit applies to existing tables only). Tenant: id (the site id, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens), accountId (the Prospectus Account UUID that owns and pays), displayName, state (active | past_due | suspended | deleted_pending | deleted), stateKey ("state#<state>" for operator lists), plan, entitlements (json), createdAt, stateChangedAt; indexes accountId and stateKey. TenantMembership: id "<tenant>#<userSub>", tenantId, userSub, userProfileId, role (admin | editor | curator | member), status, grantedBy, grantedAt; indexes userSub (for the token Lambda) and tenantId. TenantDomain: id (the hostname, lowercase), tenantId, kind (subdomain | custom), status (pending_dns | pending_certificate | active | failed | removed), verification (json), certificateRef; index tenantId. Authorisation: platform operator writes; a tenant admin reads its own; the tenant-claims and provisioning functions use IAM. All three go in a new optional model group "tenancy" so dedicated sites can leave them out of a first deploy.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): amplify/data/schema.ts (new models, OPTIONAL_MODEL_GROUPS: add tenancy), amplify/data/resource.ts, scripts/test-schema-parity.ts, lib/tenant-keys.ts (validateTenantId reused for site ids).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/tenant-records.feature):
Scenario: A tenant's members are found without a scan
    Given 3 tenants with 5 members each
    When the token Lambda looks up Ada's memberships
    Then it makes one query on the userSub index and reads only Ada's rows

Scenario: A hostname belongs to one tenant
    Given "alpha.apyr.us" is a TenantDomain of "alpha"
    When "beta" tries to add "alpha.apyr.us"
    Then it is refused

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-9f3de0. Blocks PPY-0bb0fd, PPY-c020ce, PPY-9f929e, PPY-82de58, PPY-70a429, PPY-2321aa, PPY-d7274f. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: -.

Testing: Schema parity; Behave in a sandbox; request meter shows one query per lookup.
Rollout: Releasable alone; unused until provisioning and claims ship. Index: new tables only (5 GSIs created with the tables), no change to existing tables.
Risk and mitigation: Risk: tenant id format collides with existing tenant ids (p-apyr-us, pilobol-us). Mitigation: reuse validateTenantId and reserve existing ids in the provisioning reserved list.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: new tables only: Tenant (accountId, stateKey), TenantMembership (userSub, tenantId), TenantDomain (tenantId); no index added to an existing table.
AppSync authorisation: changes: new models with tenant-admin read and operator write.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
